description: The theme the package ships gains an `@media (orientation: portrait)` block while 1.3.4 keeps resting on the scan that forbids one. The theme is no source of the library: `libs/tokens/build.mjs` writes it from the DTCG files into `libs/tokens/dist/pct.css`, and the package ships a copy as `themes/pct.css` — so a query a token build adds shipped past a scan that read the library's `src` alone. Laid on disk where the build writes it and read by the live reader (`tree`), so the case holds the path the reader takes the theme from.
